summary: Tested the BITSAT branch-matches API, the BITSAT delegation in historical-rank, the BITSAT Results 'Branch matches' UI, and the home exam-card shine. The backend was tested in isolation (dedicated DB tejas_isolated_iter105_test, X-Test-User auth override; dropped afterwards; real DB counts unchanged). The UI was tested through a TEST-ONLY bridge (port 8765) using a Playwright /api route intercept. DATASET: all 50 rows (18 Pilani, 15 Goa, 17 Hyderabad) match the official 2026-27 page at https://admissions.bits-pilani.ac.in/FD/BITSAT_cutOffs.html, crawled today. BACKEND: 36/36 new tests pass after one fix: a malformed stored main_block score (a string) used to cause a 500 and now returns 'unavailable'. Score 308 gives CS Pilani 308 (at cutoff), MNC 299, ECE 289. Score 300 gives MNC 299, ECE 289, CS Goa 274 with Hyderabad 272 as alternative. 205 gives only Pharmaceutical Engg. Hyderabad; 208 adds Environmental. Scores -130, 0, 200 and 204 give 0 B.E. matches plus 3 next targets. B.Pharm at 200 gives 1 programme across 2 campuses; Goa B.Pharm gives 0 matches and no targets. M.Sc. ties are handled deterministically. Scores 391, 426, -131, NaN, 300.5, abc and empty, and bad filters, return 422. Unauthenticated requests return 401 (also checked on the public URL). POST returns 405. Auto fixture: 110 correct and 20 wrong gives a 310 main block plus 9 bonus = 319 total. The response shows 310, original_total 319, bonus_excluded 9, and the stored document is unchanged. A 130-only mock without bonus also works. Ownership returns 404, an embargoed attempt returns 403 without leaking the score, and an active attempt returns 409. Chapter, retry, series_practice, 120-minute, +4 marking, wrong subject counts, the corrected score_version and a missing main_block are all unavailable. 21/22 existing JEE/COMEDK rank tests passed unchanged. The 22nd (test_comedk_and_bitsat) still asserted the old BITSAT contract, so I updated it and it now passes. FRONTEND: on the home page JEE is #B00000 and BITSAT is #FF9933 with dark ink #2B1600; COMEDK (#101115) and All India (#0B2D80) are unchanged. On desktop 1920 and mobile 390, light and dark, the ::before sheen moves without hover (translateX goes from about -527 to +487 within 1s, 4.8s infinite). Pause freezes the transform and sets aria-pressed true; Play resumes. With reduced motion the animation is 'none'. Focus outline is 3px, there is no page overflow, and logged-out links go to the login redirect. On the BITSAT Results page the tab and shortcut read 'Branch matches' and 'Real-exam rank' does not appear. Covered by test: 3 cards with campus, cutoff, margin, at-cutoff and alternatives; the dirty state clears stale cards; invalid input shows an error; a forced 500 shows the error and retry works; the slow-request race is aborted on edit; Use this mock restores 310, All campuses and B.E.; the source link points to the official URL with year 2026-2027. Fewer than 3 matches show honest next targets. A chapter attempt shows the unavailable reason and the manual score still works. A foreign attempt shows 'Attempt not found'. The page is forced light under OS dark on desktop and mobile with no overflow. Design issues found are listed below.

minor.issue: FIXED by tester: summary.main_block.score stored as a non-number (e.g. 'x') or main_block not a dict raised TypeError, giving a 500. Added a block_score_ok() int/bool/range guard in bitsat_branches.attempt_matches, so it now returns state=unavailable.

ui_bugs.issue: The '308 / 390' cutoff renders at about 13px instead of the intended 32px bold number. RCA: CSS '.bitsat-cutoff strong>span{font-size:13px}' also matches the wrapper <span> that the dev-only visual-edits babel plugin adds around the dynamic {item.cutoff}. The number inherits 13px even though the wrapper is display:contents. Production builds are probably fine, but the preview the user sees is affected. Fix: give the unit span a class (e.g. .bitsat-cutoff-unit) and target that class instead of '>span'.

Same RCA: '.bitsat-other-campuses>span{display:flex;justify-content:space-between}' hits the dynamic wrapper span from the .map, not the rows. Alternatives render run together, e.g. 'K K Birla Goa274Hyderabad272'. Use a class on each row span.

issues: Title 'Your marks. Your next possibilities.' is 18px (16px on mobile) but inherits the global 'h1,h2{letter-spacing:-1.8px}', so the words look squashed together. Override letter-spacing for .learning-section h2 / .bitsat-branches h2 (about -0.3px).
Eyebrow 'BITSAT · BRANCH MATCHES, NOT RANK' is 8px on mobile (10px on desktop): too small to read. Use at least 10-11px.
Grammar: '+1 marks above' should be '+1 mark above' when the margin is 1.

Minor: the sheen peak is rgba(255,255,255,0.47) over white heading text on #B00000. For a narrow, brief band the text contrast drops to about 2.6:1 while the sweep passes. BITSAT dark ink stays readable. Optional: lower the peak to about 0.3 or keep the sheen below the text layer.

action_items: Replace the child-combinator '>span' selectors in bitsat-branches.css (.bitsat-cutoff strong>span and .bitsat-other-campuses>span) with explicit classes. The cutoff number should render at 32px and each alternative campus row should show its spacing and cutoff in the preview.
Reduce the letter-spacing for the Branch matches h2 and raise the mobile eyebrow font size.
Use singular 'mark' when the margin is 1.
Optional: soften the JEE sheen peak opacity so the white heading text stays readable during the sweep.
critical_code_review_comments: attempt_matches: summary['score'] is accessed directly for original_total. This is safe after the validity gate, but use .get for robustness.
Ties: other_campuses with equal cutoffs are ordered by campus display name ('Hyderabad' before 'K K Birla Goa'). This is deterministic and matches the method copy.
Running test_iter105 and test_iter113 in one pytest process errors because each module creates its own event loop. Run them as separate commands.

success_rate.backend: 100% (36/36 new after 1 tester fix; 22/22 focused rank regression after updating 1 stale BITSAT assertion)
success_rate.frontend: about 90% functional pass; 2 CSS rendering bugs and minor design issues

test_credentials: No real login used. TEST-ONLY X-Test-User override in iso_harness. In the browser, /api/auth/session is mocked with meta.api_version='1'.
seed_data_creation: Only in dedicated DB tejas_isolated_iter105_test (dropped after the run). Synthetic BITSAT set plus 4 attempts (310+9 main/bonus, 200 low, chapter, foreign user). Real DB untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter113_bitsat_branches_isolated.py -p no:asyncio -n0. Run the iter105 rank subset separately: -k 'test_jee_exact_rows or test_jee_gaps_malformed_out_of_range_unavailable or test_comedk_and_bitsat or test_incompatible_rank_rejected or test_rank_foreign_attempt_denied'. UI bridge: cd /app/backend/tests && python iso_bridge_bitsat_iter113.py & (prints SEED113 ids). First GET /results for each attempt id to trigger grading (202, then 200). In Playwright, use page.context.route('**/api/**') to forward to 127.0.0.1:8765 with an x-test-user:student header. Mock /api/auth/session as {data:{user}, meta:{api_version:'1'}}; without api_version the app won't unwrap the response and redirects to login. Afterwards, kill the bridge and drop the test DB.
rca of the issue: Cutoff/alternatives CSS: the visual-edits babel metadata plugin, enabled only on the dev server, wraps JSX dynamic expressions in <span data-ve-dynamic> with display:contents. Child selectors like 'strong>span' match these wrappers, so inherited font-size and the intended flex layout land on the wrong element. 500 on malformed main_block: a Python int<=str comparison in the range check.
